en.headline: Observatory issues Strong Monsoon Signal with northerly winds over 40 km/h
en.dek: The signal has been in force since 09:45 HKT, with gusts occasionally reaching gale force, as a northeast monsoon affects the coast.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Strong Monsoon Signal was in force, with strong northerly winds expected and mean speeds exceeding 40 kilometres per hour. Gusts would occasionally reach gale force.

The Observatory advised people not well sheltered from the north to take precautions against strong gusty winds, and to move flower pots and other loose objects indoors. Those planning water sports or operations at sea should take special care against high winds and rough conditions, which are particularly severe offshore.

The signal was dispatched at 09:45 HKT on 24 November under the influence of an intense northeast monsoon associated with a cold front that crossed the Guangdong coast earlier in the day. Urban temperatures were expected to fall to around 18 degrees overnight, with cooler conditions continuing into Wednesday and Thursday.

zh.headline: 天文台發出強烈季候風信號 吹偏北強風陣風達烈風
zh.dek: 信號自上午9時45分生效，預料平均風速每小時超過40公里，陣風間中達烈風程度。
body: 香港天文台表示，強烈季候風信號現正生效，預料本港吹偏北強風，平均風速每小時超過四十公里，陣風間中達烈風程度。
天文台提醒，如果身在當風地方，會受到偏北風正面吹襲，應採取預防措施，以防強勁陣風帶來損害，花盆及可能被風吹倒的物件應搬入室內。打算參加水上運動或進行海上工作的人士請特別小心，以防大風大浪，離岸海域風浪尤其大。
有關天氣稿由天文台於11月24日上午9時45分發出。受冷鋒相關的強烈東北季候風影響，本港天氣逐步轉涼，晚上市區最低氣溫約18度，新界再低一兩度，周三及周四早晚仍然清涼。
